description: Bounds of a saved composition of agents and pipelines (FU-244). The Worker refuses a violation at assembly with the registered message; Main refuses it at save (relation attach, pipeline save) naming the attachment. Both sides assert this file.
runtime_message: This agent or pipeline cannot run: its attachments form a circular reference, nest deeper than allowed, or include a pipeline that pauses where the pause cannot be continued. Review its attachments and change the one that breaks the rule.
